title: Tackling The Problem
paragraphs: “It’s different now, so let’s just move on. Maybe it’s another future we walked…”
“…Yeah, looking back, I guess that’s how it is.”
“…By the way, what were we talking about? I feel like we completely went off track.”
“Naofumi saw a ghost, right?”
“Oh, that’s right. If you see it again, why not change the shield to Soul Vacuum and check? You might be able to see the ghost.”
At Itsuki’s suggestion, Father changed his shield to Soul Vacuum and looked around. But it seems like nothing is there.
“Hmm, maybe it’s different from a ghost or a soul?”
“Just stay alert. Ghosts actually exist in this world. You might as well keep Soul Vacuum with you.”
“Even Gaelion-chan can see ghosts, right…?”
“Then just bring Gaelion along.”
“I know, but lately Gaelion-chan has been blatantly harassing me, and I want to do something about it…”
“He probably finds scaring Naofumi-san cute and enjoys messing with him, like Sadina-san.”
“Ah… yeah, especially Sadina-san.”
Ren was smirking about something. I’ll never let something like that happen.
“Whatever comes, I’ll blast it away!”
“Hmm, well, fine. For now, let’s steadily suppress the nearby waves.”
“Indeed.”
“We’ve been keeping the waves around Faubrey in check to some extent too… That’s a good trend.”
“Thanks to the Filolials working hard, it’s been easy. The waves end before we even have to step in.”
“That’s the result of Naofumi-san’s research.”
“That doesn’t mean we can just sit back and relax, okay? We’re only dealing with weak enemies now… We still need to strengthen everyone.”
“It’s like managing a guild in an online game… The more members you have, the easier it gets. Is that what real guild management is like?”
Ren asked Father. Father shook his head, as if to say that’s not it.
“The ideal situation is where they fight the waves on their own without orders, preventing casualties.”
“How is that different?”
“That sounds pretty ideal, doesn’t it?”
“In reality, it’s a bit clumsier, I guess? The Filolials get along well, so they coordinate perfectly. The castle soldiers move similarly, I think.”
“Ah… now that you mention it, they did only start moving after receiving Naofumi-san’s orders. Considering that time lag, it feels like it’s faster if we just charge in ourselves.”
“Once they get used to fighting, they’ll fight like the Filolials. But no matter how many there are, there’s still a limit, right?”
“Otherwise, there’s no point in having heroes.”
“True. And when someone excels, they deserve an appropriate reward. Ideally.”
“We’re the ones receiving the money on their behalf.”
“Yeah. Ideally, we should be giving rewards to the Filolials. Equipment, hunting grounds… In a game, a guild master’s job is to provide incentives so that the same players don’t quit.”
Itsuki and Ren are both furrowing their brows in deep thought. I don’t really understand. I’ll leave all these complicated matters to Father.
“I’ve always thought that games and reality are different, but… are you saying there are similar aspects here too?”

“Yeah, I guess so. In games, large-scale events come with expensive success rewards… but in reality, it feels like we’re the ones preparing the rewards. Well, it’s true that the Filolials are working hard. I just wish we could give them some kind of reward.”
“Because you’re treating them like test subjects, Naofumi can’t raise his head to them, huh?”
At Ren’s remark, Father gave a wry smile. Calling them test subjects is rude. They’re just helping us out.
“Not at all! The Filolial-sama are cooperating because they want to help Father and the others!”

“I’d be happy if they really feel that way. It’s for the sake of the world… Also, when an incredibly powerful enemy shows up, we need to be able to protect them. I want to make Imia-chan’s relatives, Sadina-san, and Larsa-san stronger too.”
“It’s easy now, but if something appears that we can’t handle, that’s our role, huh?”
“Yeah.”
“The monsters from the waves are still weak for now… But when a powerful monster appears, that’s when the heroes have to step in.”
That’s true. We definitely need to strengthen our forces more. After nodding a few times, Father turned to us and said:

“Guild battles in games are different from real-life battles, so I think it’s best to listen to the opinions of the kingdom’s strategists. After all, they’ve sharpened their knowledge for this kind of thing.”
“In the end, our knowledge is just makeshift game tactics.”
“Yeah. Against real experts… it’s hard to win. Even if we do have the weapons of the heroes.”
“Not getting conceited, huh… That’s difficult.”
“Whatever happens, I’ll show you that I can perform heroics worthy of a thousand warriors!”
“You might be able to mow them down, but if the main camp is attacked, it’s still a loss, right? We need to keep studying regularly so we can execute our strategies properly.”

“The conversation’s been going off track for a while now, but… strong monsters from the waves, huh? Thinking back to Motoyasu-san’s stories, I wonder what I and Ren were trying to do in the previous loop.”

Itsuki asked me again. It was the revival of the Four Guardian Beasts. To be precise, Ren and Itsuki only revived the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix. But that triggered a chain reaction that led to the resurrection of all four Guardian Beasts.
“If they were getting carried away after leveling up on Cal Mira Island…”
“We weren’t getting carried away. That was the time when both Itsuki and Ren were getting beaten to a pulp by me and Father’s subordinates.”

“Beaten to a pulp… If we were neglecting this much power and getting carried away, then we definitely deserved to be pummeled. I’d bet the most likely explanation is that we saw Motoyasu-san and Naofumi-san as cheats. That’s exactly the kind of thing I’d think of.”
Are you really saying that yourself? Well, that’s exactly what happened, though.
“Indeed. Even when we tried to explain properly, they wouldn’t believe us.”

“They had already convinced themselves that their game knowledge was absolute, so there was no way they would accept it so easily. If they had done something that reckless, they probably thought they could gain the same strength as Motoyasu-san and Naofumi-san without relying on cheats…”
“It was the Spirit Tortoise. If you assume their game knowledge is correct, then the boss drop from that would, without a doubt, increase attack power by more than double.”

Oh, so they managed to arrive at that conclusion? Even if their personalities are different, they’re still the same people. That said, the equipment obtained from the Spirit Tortoise’s materials is relatively high-quality. Though this time, it might be difficult to obtain.
“Of course, I warned them not to break the Spirit Tortoise’s seal. But then Ren and Itsuki conspired and disappeared.”
“Even though it was me… there’s really no saving us, is there?”
“Well, we don’t need to do that anymore now.”
“Yeah. What’s the point of waking a sleeping beast…”
“Huh? But isn’t there some merit to unsealing it early?”

“That’s true. There might be agents of the Spirit Tortoise lurking in that country. But according to Motoyasu-san’s story, the Spirit Tortoise is a Guardian Beast that protects the world from the waves.”
Father and the others let out troubled sighs. It is indeed a difficult problem.
“According to game knowledge, an event occurs near the seventh wave where the seal of the Spirit Tortoise is broken… The question is whether we should act early to avoid damage or not.”

“It’s a tough decision. If we think about what’s best for the people, we should act quickly. But then again, the details have been simplified, and the country where the waves occur isn’t even consistent.”
“Apparently, Melromarc was the first to be hit by the waves… So they probably calculated based on that.”
“We still have time. Right now, we’re in the process of strengthening our forces. Shouldn’t we start by informing that king in Faubrey?”

“Yeah. Rather than barging in and unsealing the Spirit Tortoise only for it to go on a rampage, it’s better to have the people of that country evacuate first. If we work with other nations, we can reduce the damage.”

Oh! Ren and Itsuki are really growing. In the previous loop, Ren and Itsuki charged ahead without considering such things, thinking they could defeat it easily, believing that was the best solution. This time, I can feel confident that they won’t make the same mistakes.
“Alright then, let’s report to the king later and have him handle the diplomacy. If we get the Queen of Melromarc involved, we should at least be able to manage an evacuation.”
“Right… But even so, I’m not sure if casually defeating a Guardian Beast is the right thing to do.”
“If I remember correctly, last time, the Guardian Beast ended up harvesting the lives of people all over the world.”
“Indeed. That’s when my spear reacted.”
“Sacrificing the lives of many for the sake of peace, huh…”
“That’s not an option. We need to deal with the Spirit Tortoise issue soon.”
“Yeah, let’s take things one step at a time.”
And so, while searching for Filo-tan, we decided to resolve the Spirit Tortoise incident.
